visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand lifts a large wooden lid from a metal pot on a portable gas stove, revealing Korean stir-fried chicken covered in melted white cheese. (2) Close-up shot shows metal chopsticks pulling a large, stretchy piece of cheese from the pot. (3) A pair of chopsticks lifts a thin slice of cooked pork from a copper-colored dome grill. (4) The wooden lid is placed back onto the pot on the table. (5) Another close-up of the cheese pull, this time including a piece of chicken and a cylindrical rice cake. (6) Close-up shot of several bright red, saucy rice cakes in the pan. (7) A small oval plate of raw sliced pork belly is placed next to the grill. (8) A hand uses tongs to place raw meat onto the hot copper dome grill surrounded by broth and vegetables. (9) A golden teapot pours clear liquid into the outer ring of the copper grill where mushrooms and vegetables are simmering. (10) The camera shows a mix of meat and vegetables being stirred on the grill. (11) A stone bowl of bibimbap with an egg yolk, bean sprouts, carrots, and seaweed is presented. (12) A spoon mixes the bibimbap, showing the rice and ingredients being combined. (13) Close-up of a piece of kimchi pancake being picked up with chopsticks. (14) The kimchi pancake is dipped into a small metal bowl of red sauce. (15) A piece of glazed Korean fried chicken is held up by chopsticks against a white plate. (16) A bubbling pot of soybean paste stew (doenjang-jjigae) with tofu and meat is shown. (17) Three small metal tins containing side dishes like kimchi, radish, and bean sprouts are displayed. (18) A person pours a clear carbonated drink from a pink can into a small bronze cup. (19) The camera pans across the empty interior of a modern restaurant with wooden tables and hanging lamps. (20) The exterior of the restaurant is shown with a large banner featuring food photos and the name '韓館仁川'.
